output.reason: The release note [ev-61893aebc612] says AWSProvider.prefix was added. However, the CRD validator reports that SecretStore spec.provider.aws.prefix is in the schemas of both v0.15.0 [ev-9889c9b8706d] and v0.16.0 [ev-e08924afdc47]. That would mean the field is not new in this release. The same validator's change check also says the field appears only with the new API version v1, not as a new field of an existing version, which conflicts with the first result. Settling whether the change is a plain "added" or an addition limited to version v1 needs a per-version diff of the two CRD schemas showing whether prefix exists in v0.15.0 and under which API versions.
